docs.title: ChatNote 文档
docs.text:
ChatNote 是 ChatArch 系列的笔记工具 Python 包。当前仅提供标准包骨架、版本、帮助和真实命令树；笔记创建、存储、检索和同步功能尚未实现。文档通过命令树、能力地图和 Python 接口树说明当前边界。

站点入口：https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatNote/

docs.title: 按场景选择文档
docs.text: 场景 文档 第一次安装、运行命令行、确认包可用 CLI 树 校对当前包有哪些一等能力和边界 能力地图 从 Python 代码调用包能力 Python 接口树

docs.title: 文档栏目组织
docs.text:
文档按当前接口组织：

  • CLI 树：最直观的命令展示入口，包含真实命令树、状态和更新清单。
  • 能力地图：当前一等能力、边界和不负责的范围。
  • 接口树：命令行背后的可 import Python 接口。

docs.title: 核心入口
docs.text:
• CLI 树

    从命令行入口开始，记录已实现命令、命令状态和交互约定。

    查看 CLI 树

  • 能力地图

    用于 review 当前包的能力边界，避免把规划写成已实现功能。

    查看能力地图

  • Python 接口树

    保持命令行是薄入口，实质能力放在可 import 的 Python 接口中。

    查看接口树

docs.title: 文档状态约定
docs.text:
• 已实现：代码、测试或 CLI 路径已经存在。
  • 已验证：已经通过本地 smoke、CI 或真实服务实践验证。
  • 未实现：只写边界和计划，不写成可执行教程；实现并验证后再升级为操作文档。

docs.title: 本地预览
docs.text:
python -m pip install -e ".[docs]"
mkdocs serve

英文首页见站点语言入口：https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatNote/en/。缺少英文翻译的专题页会按 i18n fallback 回退到中文页面。

docs.title: 能力地图
docs.text: 这个页面用于校对 ChatNote 当前有哪些一等能力、哪些能力已经验证，以及哪些事情不属于当前包。

docs.title: 能力分组
docs.text:
• 命令行入口

    chatnote --help、chatnote --version、chatnote --tree 和 chatnote --tree-brief 是默认可验证入口。

  • Python 接口

    实质能力应放到可 import 的 Python 函数、类或 service 层，而不是只写在 Click 回调里。

  • 配置与环境

    当前没有业务配置，也不注册 ChatEnv 配置提供者；保留 ChatArch 依赖基线，不创建配置文件。

docs.title: 当前边界
docs.text: 能力 状态 说明 命令行基础入口 已实现 模板生成 Click group、--version、ChatStyle 共享树选项和基础测试。 ChatEnv 配置提供者 未启用 未定义业务配置，不包含 config.py 或 chatenv.configs 入口点。 业务命令 未实现 按当前包真实需求补充，不能在模板里伪造未来命令。

docs.title: 不在当前范围
docs.text:
• 不生成计划类占位页。
  • 不把未实现能力写成用户可执行教程。
  • 不在 README、docs、issue、PR 评论或 CI log 中输出 secret、token、cookie 或 Authorization header。

docs.title: CLI 能力地图
docs.text:
这篇文档是 ChatNote CLI 的简明能力地图，用来校对哪些命令已经是一等入口、哪些仍然只是边界或规划。生成后请按真实命令树更新；不要把未实现命令写成已可用操作。

可导入 Python 函数映射见 接口树。当前包能力边界见 能力地图。

docs.title: 顶层命令
docs.text:
chatnote                  # ChatNote 命令行入口
├── --help                     # 显示 CLI 帮助和已注册命令
├── --version                  # 输出当前包版本
├── --tree                     # 输出真实已注册 CLI 树和参数签名
└── --tree-brief               # 输出命令节点和描述，不含参数签名

docs.title: 基础入口
docs.text:
chatnote --help           # 验证命令已安装，并查看当前命令树
chatnote --version        # 验证当前安装版本
chatnote --tree           # 回读带参数签名的真实 CLI contract
chatnote --tree-brief     # 回读不含参数签名的简明命令树

--help、--version、--tree 和 --tree-brief 是模板默认可验证入口。两个树选项由 ChatStyle 的 add_tree_option() 提供；默认树保留参数签名，简明树只保留命令节点和描述。新增业务命令后，应将命令组单独展开，并给每个命令写一行注释。

docs.title: 业务命令
docs.text: 当前没有业务子命令；笔记管理功能不在包骨架的已实现范围内。

docs.title: 状态约定
docs.text: 状态 含义 已实现 命令、函数和测试已经存在 已验证 已通过 CI、本地 smoke 或真实服务实践 规划 / checkpoint 只保留边界说明；实现前不要写操作教程

docs.title: 实现合约
docs.text:
• 每个已实现命令都要能追到 Python 函数、类或 service 层。
  • 如果命令会写远端状态，文档必须说明凭据、权限、dry-run/checkpoint 或确认边界。
  • 新增命令时，同步更新 README、接口树、能力地图、测试和相关 Flow 页面。

docs.title: 当前接口
docs.text:
chatnote
├── __init__.py  # __version__：包版本
└── cli.py       # main：Click 命令行入口

from chatnote import __version__

当前不提供笔记业务 API。后续业务能力应实现为可导入的函数或类，命令行仅负责参数解析和输出，并同步更新测试及接口文档。

docs.title: ChatNote Docs
docs.text:
ChatNote is a ChatArch Python package for note tooling. The current package provides only a standard skeleton, version, help, and the registered CLI tree. Note creation, storage, search, and synchronization are not implemented. Use the CLI tree, capability map, and Python interface tree to inspect its current boundaries.

Site entry: https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatNote/en/

docs.title: Choose Documentation by Scenario
docs.text: Scenario Document Install the package, run the CLI, and confirm it works CLI Tree Check first-class capabilities and current boundaries Capability Map Call package behavior directly from Python Python Interface Tree

docs.title: Documentation Organization
docs.text:
Documentation is organized around the current interfaces:

  • CLI tree: the most direct command entry point, including the real command tree, status, and update checklist.
  • Capability map: first-class capabilities, boundaries, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Interface tree: importable Python APIs behind the CLI.

docs.title: Primary Entry Points
docs.text:
• CLI Tree

    Start from the CLI entry point and record implemented commands, command status, and interactive conventions.

    Open CLI Tree

  • Capability Map

    Review current package boundaries and avoid presenting planned work as implemented behavior.

    Open Capability Map

  • Python Interface Tree

    Keep the CLI thin and put substantive behavior in importable Python APIs.

    Open Interface Tree

docs.title: Documentation Status
docs.text:
• Implemented: code, tests, or CLI routes exist.
  • Verified: covered by local smoke, CI, or real-service practice.
  • Not implemented: keep as boundary and planning notes only; turn into operation docs after implementation and validation.

docs.title: Local Preview
docs.text:
python -m pip install -e ".[docs]"
mkdocs serve

The Chinese home page is available at https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatNote/. Topic pages without English translations fall back to the default Chinese content through the i18n plugin.

docs.title: Capability Map
docs.text: Use this page to check which first-class capabilities ChatNote currently owns, which ones are verified, and what remains out of scope for this package.

docs.title: Capability Groups
docs.text:
• CLI Entry

    chatnote --help, chatnote --version, chatnote --tree, and chatnote --tree-brief are the default verification entry points.

  • Python API

    Substantive behavior should live in importable Python functions, classes, or service layers rather than only in Click callbacks.

  • Config and Environment

    No business configuration or ChatEnv provider is enabled. The package retains the ChatArch dependency baseline without creating configuration files.

docs.title: Current Boundary
docs.text: Capability Status Notes CLI base entry Implemented The template generates a Click group, --version, shared ChatStyle tree options, and base tests. ChatEnv provider Not enabled No business configuration, config.py, or chatenv.configs entry point is defined. Business commands Not implemented Add these from the real package domain; do not fake future commands in the template.

docs.title: Out of Scope
docs.text:
• No plan placeholder page is generated.
  • No unimplemented capability should be written as a user operation tutorial.
  • No secret, token, cookie, or Authorization header should appear in README, docs, issues, PR comments, or CI logs.

docs.title: CLI Capability Map
docs.text:
This page is the compact capability map for the ChatNote CLI. Use it to review which commands are first-class entries and which are still boundary or planned slots. After scaffolding, update it with the real command tree; do not present unimplemented commands as available operations.

Importable Python functions are mapped in Interface Tree. Current package boundaries are tracked in Capability Map.

docs.title: Top-Level Commands
docs.text:
chatnote                  # ChatNote command-line entry
├── --help                     # Show CLI help and registered commands
├── --version                  # Print the current package version
├── --tree                     # Print the registered CLI tree with parameter signatures
└── --tree-brief               # Print command nodes and descriptions without signatures

docs.title: Base Entries
docs.text:
chatnote --help           # Verify the command is installed and inspect the current command tree
chatnote --version        # Verify the installed version
chatnote --tree           # Read back the CLI contract with parameter signatures
chatnote --tree-brief     # Read back command nodes and descriptions only

--help, --version, --tree, and --tree-brief are the scaffolded verification entries. ChatStyle's add_tree_option() provides both tree flags: the default tree keeps parameter signatures, while the brief tree keeps only command nodes and descriptions. When adding business commands, expand each command group separately and annotate every command line.

docs.title: Business Commands
docs.text: No business subcommands are implemented. Note management remains outside the current skeleton.

docs.title: Status Contract
docs.text: Status Meaning Implemented Command, function, and tests exist Verified Covered by CI, local smoke, or real-service practice Planned / checkpoint Keep only boundary notes; do not write operation tutorials before implementation

docs.title: Implementation Contract
docs.text:
• Every implemented command must map back to a Python function, class, or service layer.
  • If a command writes remote state, document credentials, permissions, dry-run/checkpoint behavior, or confirmation boundaries.
  • When adding a command, update README, the interface tree, capability map, tests, and related flow pages together.

docs.title: Current Interfaces
docs.text:
chatnote
├── __init__.py  # __version__: package version
└── cli.py       # main: Click command-line entry point

from chatnote import __version__

No note-management API is currently provided. Future domain behavior should live in importable functions or classes, with thin CLI adapters and matching tests and interface documentation.
